evidence.claim: Il Lanificio Cerruti nasce a Biella nel 1881 e da oltre un secolo produce soprattutto per il mercato estero, da Tokyo a Hong Kong.
evidence.quote: The Lanificio Cerruti represent an adventure in Biella, began in 1881 but that has its origins in 1770 and that has gone through 250 years of innovation || For over a century, most of the production has been destined for the foreign market. From Biella to Tokyo and Hong Kong
